preconditions.description: The number of days m must be between 1 and 50.
The number of stores n must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= n - 1 for s_i in range(m))
preconditions.description: For each day, the number of stores Dora bought from must be between 1 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(indices)) == s_i for indices in input_indices)
preconditions.description: The indices of stores Dora bought from must be distinct for each day.

postconditions.description: Output 'possible' if there exist positive integers a_i such that Dora beats Swiper on every day.
Output 'impossible' if no such positive integers a_i exist.
